title: Solana sets Oct. 21 for Alpenglow consensus switch
description: The Solana Foundation said Alpenglow activates at epoch 1064 on Oct. 21, 2026, replacing TowerBFT voting with a system targeting 150-millisecond finality.

title: Richard Heart detained in Istanbul on Finnish request
description: Turkish media reported on Oct. 14, 2026 that HEX founder Richard Heart was detained in Istanbul under an Interpol Red Notice sought by Finland.

title: Bitget Lists Jio Pre-IPO Perpetual Futures
description: Bitget's JIOUSDT pre-IPO futures are live with a 20x trading limit as Jio Platforms prepares its October 21-23 share offering in India.

title: Payward agrees to buy Saldo Bank for EU banking license
description: Payward said on Oct. 14, 2026 it signed a deal to acquire Saldo Bank, a Lithuania-licensed bank, with closing expected in 2027 pending regulatory approval.

title: VanEck withdraws Lido staked ether ETF filing
description: VanEck said in an Oct. 14, 2026 SEC filing it will not proceed with its Lido staked ether ETF, ending the first American attempt at a stETH fund.
